major_deviations.claim_in_article: “AI Lawsuits Are About More Than Money” (headline)
major_deviations.issue: The headline generalizes from the specific lawsuit in the Ledger to AI lawsuits more broadly.
major_deviations.explanation: The Ledger verifies non-monetary demands in this particular case, not across AI lawsuits generally. The scope generalization is already present in the Japanese source headline.
